diagnosis: The freight shipment tracking controller queries MongoDB documents by trackingNumber without verifying that the shipperCompanyCode matches the authenticated shipper. Forwarding companies can inspect confidential cargo manifests, customs tariff classifications, and destination port consignees belonging to competing logistics providers.
